data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for displaying inline video on Android, iOS, macOS, and web.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to embed and control video playback inside Flutter widgets across multiple platforms. It provides controllers to manage playback state, speed, positioning, and tracks.
use_when: You need to play local or network videos inline with other Flutter widgets.
You require cross-platform video playback supporting Android, iOS, macOS, and web.
avoid_when: You are building a complex audio/video streaming app that requires advanced background playback or comprehensive custom media controls out of the box (consider chewie or media_kit instead).
You need to play video using `VideoPlayerController.file` on the web platform.
strengths: Official Flutter team package with broad platform support.
Supports adaptive streams, audio/video track selection, and playback speed configuration.
weaknesses: Web platform capabilities depend heavily on individual browser implementations.
Requires manual implementation of UI controls (play/pause, progress bars).
data.setup_notes: Requires adding network permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and optionally configuring NSAppTransportSecurity in iOS Info.plist or network client entitlements for macOS.

alternatives.name: chewie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a pre-built Material/Cupertino video player UI on top of video_player.

alternatives.name: media_kit
alternatives.why_pick_it: A heavy-duty general-purpose audio and video player for Flutter based on libmpv.
